title: Alexandre Laizet on The French Debt Crisis: “Europe is in Need of Bitcoin”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Alexandre Laizet on The French Debt Crisis: “Europe is in Need of Bitcoin” France hits 120% debt-to-GDP. Capital B's Alexandre Laizet explains why misspent debt and currency debasement make the case for a Bitcoin treasury strategy. This post Alexandre Laizet on The French Debt Crisis: “Europe is in Need of Bitcoin” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
